purpose: One starter challenge per verified stream; exercises use canonical shared lab methodology and do not duplicate lab engines

activities.title: Explore and architect: My Purpose Identity
activities.challenge: Identify one realistic enterprise problem in this stream, document stakeholders and constraints, and propose a measurable improvement using the shared SuperLabs method.
steps: Frame the problem and identify stakeholder outcomes
Document a current-state workflow and risks
Propose a future-state experiment using SL01
Define evidence, success criteria, and review questions
measurable_outcomes: One testable hypothesis with measurable success criteria
reflection_prompts: What assumption would you test first?
What would change your recommendation?
